rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Floribunda.
Registration name: Parfum d'Orléans ®
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink. Orange center. Strong fragrance. 60 to 70 petals. Average diameter 4". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 32" (70 to 80cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
